zh-CN.title: 从“手动写代码”到“委派给 Agent”：Xcode 生产环境真实工作流复盘
zh-CN.description: 一个资深 iOS/macOS 团队在连续 90 天将生产任务委派给自主 Agent 后的深度复盘：从代码编写者到系统审查者的心智模型迁移、度量指标与效能陷阱。
zh-CN.content:
TL;DR：将 AI 从“代码补全插件（Copilot）”升级为“自主执行代理（Agent）”，不是效率工具的微调，而是一场软件工程生产关系的重构。我们在 3 个月的实际商业开发中跟踪了 400+ 次由 Agent 驱动的提交。复盘数据显示：代码产出速度提升了近 300%，但如果不加约束，代码审查（Code Review）耗时激增 210%，架构腐化风险上升。本文分享如何通过“契约驱动”、“分级委派”与“自动化验证”建立可持续的高效 Agent 协作流。

一、 度量数据：90 天实验的冰与火

我们在一个拥有 25 万行 Swift 代码、涵盖 AppKit 与 SwiftUI 的 macOS 商业项目中，进行了为期一个季度的 Agent 协作实验。核心度量指标的变化揭示了深刻的真相：

评估指标 传统纯手工模式 Agent 自由发挥模式 约束化 Agent 协同模式（最终形态）
单特性首次实现时间 18.5 小时 4.2 小时 (-77%) 6.5 小时 (-65%)
平均 PR 变更代码行数 180 行 890 行 (+394%) 140 行 (-22%)
PR 评审阻塞时间 (Wait Time) 4.0 小时 14.5 小时 (+262%) 2.5 小时 (-37%)
合并后引入 Regression 缺陷数 0.8 个/Sprint 3.4 个/Sprint (+325%) 0.3 个/Sprint (-62%)

数据清晰地呈现了早期误区：Agent 写得越快，如果一次性生成的代码量过大，人类 Reviewer 就会陷入认知超载。评审者无法细致阅读 800 行代码，最终只能粗略浏览或直接放行，导致隐匿的边界条件失效与逻辑回归。

二、 心智模型的根本转变：从 Driver 到 Tech Lead

在传统的结对编程或单兵开发中，开发者的注意力集中在：

  • “这个语法怎么写？”
  • “这个 API 的参数顺序是什么？”
  • “如何用正则表达式匹配这个格式？”

而在成熟的 Agentic Coding 模式下，资深工程师必须主动放弃对实现细节的手工输入依赖，转变为一名严厉的 Tech Lead：

flowchart LR
    subgraph Human["资深工程师 (Architect & Tech Lead)"]
        A1[系统架构设计]
        A2[抽象边界定义]
        A3[验收证据审查]
    end

    subgraph Agent["AI Agent (Execution Assistant)"]
        B1[阅读相关模块接口]
        B2[生成原子实现]
        B3[编写针对性测试]
    end

    subgraph Platform["底层确定性设施 (Tooling & Sandbox)"]
        C1[编译构建门禁]
        C2[TSan / 并发分析]
        C3[Git 状态审计]
    end

    A1 --> B1
    A2 --> B2
    B2 --> C1
    C1 -->|通过| C2
    C2 -->|产出证据| A3

你对 Agent 说的每一句话，本质上是在制定需求规格书（Spec）。如果你的指令存在二义性，Agent 就会用它的统计概率去填补空白，而这个空白通常是错误的。

三、 五大生产落地原则

在经历多次教训后，我们总结了五条不可逾越的实践法则：

1. 窄域上下文供给（Scope Narrowing）

永远不要让 Agent 在一个包含上百个目录的工程里进行模糊全量搜索。正确的做法是由工程师直接定位到 2~3 个核心文件，将其显式作为输入上下文传入：“基于 PaymentServiceProtocol.swift，为新渠道实现一个 StripePaymentHandler”。

2. 计划与执行分离（Two-Pass Verification）

复杂改动严格要求 Agent 分两步走：

  • Pass 1：只输出改动方案、影响模块与自测计划，不写任何生产代码。人工确认方案无误后，再允许进入代码编写。
  • Pass 2：针对性修改，并强制其在本地运行最小可复现构建。

3. 小步快跑与原子提交（Atomic Iteration）

一个任务只做一件事。严禁将“重构旧模块”与“添加新接口”放在同一个 Agent 任务中。一旦发现 Agent 开始偏离主题修改无关文件，立即执行 git checkout 撤销并重新收紧 Prompt 边界。

四、 工程师的未来生存壁垒

Agent 不会淘汰工程师，但“只会搬砖写基础 CRUD 的打字员”将无立足之地。

当代码生成变成几乎零成本的日用品，最昂贵的资产变成了对复杂系统的抽象能力、对边缘故障的敏锐嗅觉、以及对架构可维护性的深刻洞察。

en.title: From "Manual Coding" to "Delegation to Agents": A Retrospective of Real-World Workflows in Xcode Production
en.description: A deep retrospective of a senior iOS/macOS team after delegating production tasks to autonomous agents for 90 consecutive days: the mental model shift from code writer to system reviewer, metrics, and performance pitfalls.
en.content:
TL;DRUpgrading AI from a "code completion plugin (Copilot)" to an "autonomous execution agent (Agent)" is not merely a fine-tuning of efficiency tools, but a complete restructuring of software engineering production relations. In three months of actual commercial development, we tracked over 400 Agent-driven commits. Retrospective data shows that code output speed increased by nearly 300%, but without constraints, code review time surged by 210%, increasing the risk of architectural corruption. This article shares how to establish a sustainable and efficient Agent collaboration flow through "contract-driven," "hierarchical delegation," and "automated verification."

I. Measurement Data: Ice and Fire in a 90-Day Experiment

We conducted a quarter-long Agent collaboration experiment in a commercial macOS project with 250,000 lines of Swift code, encompassing both AppKit and SwiftUI. Changes in core metrics revealed profound truths:

评估指标 传统纯手工模式 Agent 自由发挥模式 约束化 Agent 协同模式（最终形态）
Single feature first implementation time 18.5 小时 4.2 小时 (-77%) 6.5 小时 (-65%)
Average number of lines of code changed in a PR 180 行 890 行 (+394%) 140 行 (-22%)
PR review waiting time 4.0 小时 14.5 小时 (+262%) 2.5 小时 (-37%)
The number of Regression defects is introduced after the merger. 0.8 个/Sprint 3.4 个/Sprint (+325%) 0.3 个/Sprint (-62%)

The data clearly reveals the early misconceptions:The faster the agent is written, the more cognitive overload a human reviewer will experience if the amount of code generated at once is too large.Reviewers were unable to thoroughly read 800 lines of code, ultimately only able to skim through them or approve them outright, leading to the failure of hidden boundary conditions and logical regressions.

II. A Fundamental Shift in Mental Models: From Driver to Tech Lead

In traditional pair programming or solo development, developers focus their attention on:

  • How do you write this syntax?
  • What is the order of the parameters in this API?
  • How can I use regular expressions to match this format?

In a mature Agentic Coding model, senior engineers mustActively abandon the reliance on manual input of implementation detailsHe transformed into a strict Tech Lead:

flowchart LR
    subgraph Human["资深工程师 (Architect & Tech Lead)"]
        A1[系统架构设计]
        A2[抽象边界定义]
        A3[验收证据审查]
    end

    subgraph Agent["AI Agent (Execution Assistant)"]
        B1[阅读相关模块接口]
        B2[生成原子实现]
        B3[编写针对性测试]
    end

    subgraph Platform["底层确定性设施 (Tooling & Sandbox)"]
        C1[编译构建门禁]
        C2[TSan / 并发分析]
        C3[Git 状态审计]
    end

    A1 --> B1
    A2 --> B2
    B2 --> C1
    C1 -->|通过| C2
    C2 -->|产出证据| A3

Every word you say to the agent is essentially a strategy for development.Requirements Specification (Spec)If your command is ambiguous, the agent will fill in the gaps using its statistical probabilities, and these gaps are usually incorrect.

III. Five Principles for Production Implementation

After learning from numerous lessons, we have summarized five inviolable principles of practice:

1. Narrowing Scope Context Provisioning

Never let the agent perform a fuzzy full search in a project containing hundreds of directories. The correct approach is for engineers to directly locate 2-3 core files and explicitly pass them as input context: "based on..."PaymentServiceProtocol.swiftTo achieve a new channelStripePaymentHandler”。

2. Separation of Planning and Execution (Two-Pass Verification)

Complex modifications strictly require the Agent to proceed in two steps:

  • Pass 1Only output the modification plan, affected modules, and self-test plan; do not write any production code. Code writing is only permitted after the plan has been manually verified as correct.
  • Pass 2Targeted modifications were made, and it was forced to run a minimal reproducible build locally.

3. Small, rapid steps and Atomic Iteration

One task should do only one thing. It is strictly forbidden to combine "refactoring old modules" and "adding new interfaces" into the same Agent task. If the Agent starts deviating from its intended purpose and modifying irrelevant files, execute the command immediately.git checkoutUndo and re-tighten the Prompt boundary.

IV. The Barriers to Future Survival for Engineers

Agents won't eliminate engineers, but "typists who only know how to do basic CRUD operations" will have nowhere to go.

When code generation becomes a near-zero-cost everyday commodity, the most expensive asset becomes...The ability to abstract complex systems, a keen sense of edge faults, and a deep understanding of architectural maintainability.。
